title: Exploring Soccer Data for Analysis
text: Tools like StatsBomb’s open data SDK, mplsoccer, and pandas have made Python the lingua franca for everything from event data wrangling to expected goals modeling. This post walks through setting up a reproducible Python based analytics environment. Since I primarily use R, I am transitioning to using Python and this post walks through the analytics workflow.
